description: pkix-path/tests/fixtures/policy-checks/gen.py: The module docstring at line 22 states 'Oracle: openssl verify -CAfile <root.pem> -untrusted <int.pem> <leaf.pem>' but this oracle command cannot be run for webpki-self-signed-365d.der (which is self-signed: no separate root/int). The file also doesn't include a comment showing the actual openssl command used to verify the self-signed fixture. For reproducibility, a comment like 'Oracle: openssl verify -CAfile webpki-self-signed.pem webpki-self-signed.pem → OK' should be added near the fixture generation. Minor doc issue.
title: gen.py does not include webpki-self-signed fixture in OpenSSL oracle comments
